jobs.title: Leader principal ou leader principale, Oracle EPM Planning
jobs.description:
Type de poste :
Permanent Modèle de travail :
Hybride Numéro de demande:
133501 Lieu principal :
Toronto, ON Emplacements additionnels :
Toronto, ON; Brossard, QC; Burlington, ON; Calgary, AB; Edmonton, AB; Fredericton, NB; Halifax, NS; Kitchener, ON; Laval, QC; Moncton, NB; Montréal, QC; Ottawa, ON; Régina, SK; Saint John, NB; Saskatoon, SK; St. John's, NL; Vancouver, BC; Victoria, BC; Winnipeg, MB; ville de Québec, QC

Notre raison d’être

Chez Deloitte, notre raison d’être est d’avoir une influence marquante. Nous existons pour inspirer et aider nos gens, nos organisations, nos collectivités et nos pays à prospérer en créant un avenir meilleur. Notre travail soutient une société prospère où les gens peuvent s’épanouir et saisir des occasions. Il renforce la confiance des consommateurs et des entreprises, aide les organisations à trouver des moyens créatifs de déployer des capitaux, habilite des institutions sociales et économiques justes, fiables et efficaces, et permet à nos amis, à nos familles et à nos collectivités de profiter de la qualité de vie qui accompagne un avenir durable. Étant le plus grand cabinet de services professionnels détenu et exploité à 100 % par des Canadiens dans notre pays, nous sommes fiers de travailler aux côtés de nos clients pour avoir une influence positive sur tous les Canadiens.

En incarnant notre raison d’être, nous aurons une influence marquante.

Diversifiez votre carrière au sein du Cabinet.
Tirez parti d’avantages souples, proactifs et pratiques qui favorisent une culture de bien-être et la création de liens solides.
Approfondissez vos connaissances grâce au mentorat d’experts et à du coaching au travail.

--

À quoi ressemblera votre journée type

En tant que leader principal(e) d’Oracle EPM Planning (directeur(trice) principal(e)), vous serez responsable des programmes de planification d’entreprise et de transformation de la fonction finance pour façonner des solutions, de la gestion de relations avec des clients et de l’exécution de nombreuses missions.

À ce titre, vous devrez faire ce qui suit :

Superviser simultanément la prestation de bout en bout de l’architecture de solutions et de nombreuses missions Oracle EPM Planning, y compris l’étendue, le plan de travail, la gestion des risques et des problèmes (RAID), la gestion financière, la gestion de la qualité et les résultats globaux de la prestation.
Fournir des conseils sur les stratégies de transformation de la fonction finance et de planification d’entreprise.
Assumer la responsabilité de la conception de la solution et des décisions en matière d’architecture.
Diriger la définition des processus de planification pour l’état futur et des modèles d’exploitation en tirant parti des capacités d’Oracle EPM pour rehausser l’efficacité et les perspectives d’affaires.
Favoriser l’harmonisation entre les finances, les TI et les parties prenantes de la direction pour favoriser des processus décisionnels efficaces et veiller à la réussite des programmes.
Assurer la direction fonctionnelle des solutions Oracle EPM Planning, y compris la gamme complète de modules EPBCS.
Superviser la conception du modèle de planification et l’architecture des solutions (catalyseurs, hypothèses, scénarios, flux des travaux, production de rapports) et s’assurer que les solutions sont adaptables, durables et harmonisées aux objectifs du client.
Veiller à l’exécution de cas d’utilisation de grande qualité sur le plan de la planification, des prévisions et de la gestion du rendement.
Superviser les activités de test et de déploiement, notamment la stratégie de test, le tri des défectuosités, l’état de préparation aux essais d’acceptation par l’utilisateur et la planification du déploiement, afin de s’assurer que les solutions sont adoptées avec succès et créent la valeur commerciale attendue.
Favoriser le développement des affaires en faisant preuve de leadership sur le plan des offres de service, en effectuant des présentations auprès des clients et en assurant la gestion des relations.
Contribuer aux stratégies de mise en marché, à l’élaboration d’offres de service et au leadership d’opinion au sein de l’équipe Oracle EPM.
Diriger et encadrer des équipes de prestation dans le cadre de nombreuses missions, afin de promouvoir une solide discipline d’exécution et leur perfectionnement grâce au coaching, au mentorat et à une rétroaction de qualité.
Contribuer au recrutement, à l’intégration et au développement de capacités au sein de l’équipe Oracle EPM.
Demeurer au courant des nouveautés liées au produit Oracle EPM et intégrer les innovations pertinentes à la prestation de services, en particulier les capacités d’IA/IGR telles que la planification prédictive, Auto Predict et IPM Insights.
Aider les clients à mettre en œuvre des capacités de planification habilitées par l’IA pour améliorer l’exactitude des prévisions, automatiser la création de perspectives et améliorer les processus décisionnels.
Façonner les réflexions de clients sur le rôle de l’IA dans le cadre de la planification d’entreprise, et la création d’un équilibre entre l’innovation et la mise en œuvre de mesures pratiques qui créent de la valeur.

La personne retenue aura l’occasion de faire partie de notre premier cabinet de services-conseils qui travaille à la fine pointe de mises en œuvre d’Oracle Cloud. Vous travaillerez auprès d’une grande variété de clients et jouerez un rôle important dans certaines des mises en œuvre les plus stimulantes à l’échelle mondiale.

Renseignements sur l’équipe

L’équipe adopte et incarne la raison d’être du Cabinet – c’est-à-dire avoir une influence marquante –, tout en vous poussant à vous surpasser, vous-même et votre équipe, afin de trouver des solutions aux problèmes les plus importants de nos clients, de nos gens et de la société.

Veiller au perfectionnement de gens et d’équipes hautement performantes en leur offrant des occasions stimulantes et pertinentes.
Offrir un service à la clientèle exceptionnel en obtenant un rendement élevé, tout en favorisant la collaboration entre les équipes et les régions.
Exercer une influence positive sur les clients, les équipes et les gens en donnant l’exemple et en établissant de solides relations.
Veiller à ce que les gens soient sur la même longueur d’onde et à ce que les priorités soient harmonisées aux objectifs d’affaires des clients et de Deloitte.

Assez parlé de nous, parlons de vous

Vous Avez Le Profil Suivant

Au moins huit années d’expérience dans la prestation de solutions Oracle EPM Planning dans des environnements de consultation ou d’entreprise.
Expérience dans la supervision de programmes de transformation de la fonction finance et de la planification d’entreprise pour améliorer les processus de budgétisation, de prévision et de présentation de l’information.
Expérience éprouvée dans la mise en œuvre de bout en bout d’Oracle EPM Planning tout au long du cycle de vie du projet, des exigences au déploiement et à la stabilisation.
Expérience éprouvée en gestion de missions de grande envergure ou simultanées, ainsi qu’en gestion de l’exécution, des parties prenantes et des aspects financiers des missions.
Excellente expertise fonctionnelle liée aux plateformes Oracle EPM Planning, y compris les systèmes EPBCS, PBCS et Hyperion Planning), et aux modules associés (Workforce, Capital, Project, Strategic Modelling).
Compréhension approfondie des processus de planification et d’analyse financières, y compris la budgétisation, les prévisions, la planification à long terme et la gestion du rendement.
Expérience de la gestion des aspects financiers des projets, de leur étendue et des risques liés aux missions complexes.
Connaissances pratiques des intégrations, de l’architecture des métadonnées et des technologies connexes (p. ex., gestion des données, FDMEE, règles d’affaires Essbase, création de scripts dans Groovy, et IPA REST).
Solides compétences en résolution de problèmes et capacité d’analyser et de résoudre des problèmes d’affaires complexes au moyen d’approches structurées.
Excellentes aptitudes pour la communication et les relations interpersonnelles, capacité de produire du contenu prêt à l’emploi et de communiquer avec les parties prenantes de haut niveau avec assurance.
Compréhension des capacités de planification propulsées par l’IA dans Oracle EPM, telles que Auto Predict et IPM Insights, capacité à les utiliser de manière responsable afin d’améliorer l’exactitude des prévisions et l’efficacité de la planification, et expérience de leur application (ou soutien de l’application).
Baccalauréat en finances, en comptabilité, en technologies de l’information ou dans un domaine connexe; une maîtrise ou un titre professionnel (p. ex., CPA, MBA) est un atout.
Certifications Oracle EPM (p. ex., certification Oracle Cloud EPM) : considérées comme un atout important.

Le bilinguisme en français et en anglais est requis pour ce poste en raison de la nature du rôle ayant des interactions avec les clients et les équipes de projet nationaux et mondiaux.

Rémunération totale

L’échelle salariale pour ce poste est de 105,000 $ à 234,000 $. Certaines personnes peuvent être admissibles à notre programme de prime. Sur le plan salarial, Deloitte se concentre sur l’équité et la compétitivité. Nous établissons régulièrement des comparaisons aux données de référence du marché établies pour divers postes, secteurs, cibles et niveaux. Notre approche est fondée sur l’importance de reconnaître les forces et les contributions uniques de chaque personne et de récompenser celle-ci pour la valeur qu’elle apporte.

La rémunération totale offerte par Deloitte s’étend bien au-delà des programmes traditionnels de rémunération et d’avantages sociaux et est conçue pour reconnaître les contributions des employés, favoriser le mieux-être personnel et soutenir la croissance du Cabinet. En plus de nos jours de congé payés réguliers, quelques exemples incluent : 4 000 $ par an pour les avantages de soutien en santé mentale, un compte de dépenses flexibles de 1 300 $, des fermetures à l'échelle de l'entreprise connues sous le nom de "Jours Deloitte", des journées dédiées à l'apprentissage (connues sous le nom de Jours de Développement et d'Innovation), des arrangements de travail flexibles et une structure de travail hybride.

Notre promesse à nos gens : Deloitte est là où vous pouvez propulsez vos ambitions.

Vous, et plus encore.

Évoluez au sein d’une équipe passionnée et déterminée à apprendre et à développer de nouvelles compétences. Bâtissez votre réseau et faites le plein d’expériences qui vous permettront de vous épanouir et vous mèneront vers la prochaine étape de votre carrière.

Vos chemins nous portent plus loin.

La diversité de vos compétences, perspectives et expériences nous rend meilleurs. Nous voulons que vous vous sentiez comme chez vous, qui que vous soyez et d’où que vous veniez. Nous vous oﬀrons des options de travail ﬂexibles et personnalisées pour répondre à vos besoins, peu importe votre mode de vie.

Devenez le leader que vous désirez être.

Certains dirigent des équipes, d’autres sont au cœur d’un changement de culture, d’autres encore bâtissent une expertise de pointe. Nous soutiendrons votre croissance en tant que leader par l’entremise d’expériences, d’occasions et de défis variés et enrichissants.

Ayez autant de carrières que vous le souhaitez.

Nous sommes en mesure de vous offrir de nouveaux rôles et de nouvelles responsabilités, et de vous aider à vous y préparer. Notre objectif est de conjuguer vos aspirations à vos compétences et à l’excellence de votre savoir-faire. Nous sommes l’endroit pour développer un réseau durable d’amis, de pairs et de mentors.

La balle est dans votre camp

Chez Deloitte, nous avons à cœur de faire des affaires de manière inclusive – cela commence par une diversité parmi les collègues de toutes les compétences! Deloitte encourage tous les candidats qualifiés qui représentent la diversité des collectivités partout au Canada

jobs.title: Director of Finance And Accounting
jobs.description:
About the Company

Our client has recently become a publicly traded company and is seeking an experienced CPA-level Finance Consultant to help strengthen and implement the financial processes, controls, reporting infrastructure, and accounting practices required to operate effectively as a public company. This is a hands-on consulting engagement for an experienced accounting professional who understands the increased reporting, control, audit, and compliance requirements that come with operating as a public company. The successful candidate will assess the current finance environment, identify gaps, and work closely with management and the finance team to implement scalable processes and controls that support the organization's continued growth.

About the Role

This is a hands-on consulting engagement for an experienced accounting professional who understands the increased reporting, control, audit, and compliance requirements that come with operating as a public company. The successful candidate will assess the current finance environment, identify gaps, and work closely with management and the finance team to implement scalable processes and controls that support the organization's continued growth.

Responsibilities

Assess existing accounting and finance processes and identify opportunities for improvement within the newly public organization.
Design and implement scalable financial processes, controls, and procedures appropriate for a public-company environment.
Strengthen month-end, quarter-end, and year-end financial close processes.
Improve financial reporting processes and ensure timely and accurate reporting.
Develop and document accounting policies, procedures, and internal controls.
Support the development and implementation of public-company financial controls and reporting requirements.
Work closely with senior management, external auditors, legal advisors, and other professional advisors.
Prepare and organize financial information and supporting documentation required for external reporting and audits.
Identify gaps in existing processes and implement practical solutions.
Improve reconciliation, approval, documentation, and reporting processes across the finance function.
Assist with audit readiness and coordinate responses to external auditor requests.
Develop clear and repeatable process documentation for the finance team.
Assess existing systems and recommend improvements where required.
Provide hands-on guidance and mentorship to accounting and finance staff.
Help establish a finance infrastructure capable of supporting the company's continued growth as a public organization.

Qualifications

CPA designation required.
7+ years of progressive accounting and finance experience.
Experience working within a public company or recently public organization.
Strong understanding of financial reporting, accounting processes, internal controls, and audit requirements.
Experience implementing or improving financial processes and controls.
Strong knowledge of month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close procedures.
Experience working directly with external auditors.
Experience with public-company reporting and compliance requirements.
Strong analytical and process-improvement skills.
Excellent communication and stakeholder-management abilities.
Ability to work independently and take ownership of projects in a fast-paced environment.

jobs.title: Director, FP&A – Corporate Functions
jobs.description:
Description & Requirements

Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.

Role Overview

The Director, Corporate Functions FP&A serves as the senior finance partner and trusted advisor to EA's Corporate Functions, including People Experience, Real Estate, Finance, Legal, and Corporate Development.

Reporting to the Head of Enterprise FP&A and Chief of Staff, you will lead financial planning, forecasting, investment evaluation, and performance accountability across Corporate Functions. As the Director you are responsible for ensuring capital is allocated effectively, investments are aligned to enterprise priorities, and leaders have the insights needed to make informed decisions. Success in this role requires the ability to translate complex financial and operational information into clear recommendations that influence executive decision-making and drive business outcomes.

The role leads and develops an established team of four directs and three shared service finance professionals, and is responsible for building organizational capability, fostering analytical excellence, and strengthening strategic business partnership across the Corporate Functions. This position follows a hybrid work model, requiring three days per week in an EA office. 

What You Will Do

Serve as the primary finance partner to Corporate Function executives, providing strategic counsel, financial insights, and decision support.
Lead annual planning, quarterly forecasting, and long-range planning activities across Corporate Functions, ensuring alignment with enterprise priorities, planning assumptions, and financial objectives.
Drive scenario planning, risk assessment, and sensitivity analysis to support proactive decision-making and effective resource allocation. This work involves complex financial modeling and cross functional collaboration.
Provide financial leadership and decision support for significant corporate investments and strategic initiatives, including workplace experience and real estate, people programs, and enterprise capabilities.
Partner with business owners to evolve KPI frameworks and performance measures that connect functional investments to business outcomes, ensuring investment performance and value realization are effectively tracked and communicated.
Deliver monthly and quarterly management reporting, providing clear analysis of performance, key business drivers, financial risks, and opportunities.
Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team of finance professionals, building strong analytical, forecasting, and business partnership capabilities.
Drive continuous improvement and financial excellence by leading planning and process enhancements, advancing operational effectiveness, and leveraging technology and AI-enabled solutions to improve planning, reporting, and decision support.
Partner with Enterprise FP&A to help establish and scale EA's connected financial planning framework, strengthening planning rigor, consistency, and transparency across Corporate Functions.

What You Bring

10+ years of progressive experience in FP&A, corporate finance, strategic finance, or related fields.
Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related quantitative field. MBA, CFA, or CPA is valued
Proficiency in Accounting and general GAAP knowledge
5+ years of experience leading, coaching, and developing finance professionals and building an inclusive environment.
Experience serving as a finance partner to senior executives and influencing decisions in a complex, matrixed environment.
Strong executive communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to translate complex information into clear and actionable insights.
Advanced financial modeling, analytical, and problem-solving skills, with hands-on experience using modern ERP and FP&A planning platforms.
Experience leveraging AI and technology solutions to improve financial processes, analytics, and decision-making.

Pay Transparency - North America

Compensation And Benefits

The ranges listed below are what EA in good faith expects to pay applicants for this role in these locations at the time of this posting. If you reside in a different location, a recruiter will advise on the applicable range and benefits. Pay offered will be determined based on a number of relevant business and candidate factors (e.g. education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, or business needs).

PAY RANGES

British Columbia (depending on location e.g. Vancouver vs. Victoria) *$160,700 - $224,700 CAD
California (depending on location e.g. Los Angeles vs. San Francisco) *$182,600 - $276,300 USD

Pay is just one part of the overall compensation at EA.

In the US, we offer a package of benefits including paid time off (3 weeks per year to start), 80 hours per year of sick time, 16 paid company holidays per year, 10 weeks paid time off to bond with baby, medical/dental/vision insurance, life insurance, disability insurance, and 401(k) to regular full-time employees. Certain roles may also be eligible for bonus and other incentive programs.

For Canada, we offer a package of benefits including vacation (3 weeks per year to start), 10 days per year of sick time, paid top-up to EI/QPIP benefits up to 100% of base salary when you welcome a new child (12 weeks for maternity, and 4 weeks for parental/adoption leave), extended health/dental/vision coverage, life insurance, disability insurance, retirement plan to regular full-time employees. Certain roles may also be eligible for bonus and other incentive programs.

About Electronic Arts

We’re proud to have an extensive portfolio of games and experiences, locations around the world, and opportunities across EA. We value adaptability, resilience, creativity, and curiosity. From leadership that brings out your potential, to creating space for learning and experimenting, we empower you to do great work and pursue opportunities for growth.

We adopt a holistic approach to our benefits programs, emphasizing physical, emotional, financial, career, and community wellness to support a balanced life. Our packages are tailored to meet local needs and may include healthcare coverage, mental well-being support, retirement savings, paid time off, family leaves, complimentary games, and more. We nurture environments where our teams can always bring their best to what they do.

Electronic Arts is an equal opportunity employer. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, genetic information, religion, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, marital status, family status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We will also consider employment qualified applicants with criminal records in accordance with applicable law. EA also makes workplace accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities as required by applicable law.

jobs.title: Senior Strategy Director
jobs.description:
This job posting is available in English and Canadian French. Please scroll down for the French version.

Cette offre d'emploi est disponible en anglais et en français (Canada). Veuillez faire défiler pour la version française.

________________________________

Remote | U.S. & Canada Only | Full-Time

Compensation:

$150,000 USD (for U.S based candidates)
$150,000 CAD (for Canadian based candidates)

The Senior Strategy Director plays a central role in shaping how the agency thinks, plans, and delivers impact for clients. This role is responsible for defining strategic direction across priority accounts and ensuring that media, creative, SEO, CRM, web, and analytics teams are aligned to a unified business objective.

This role requires an insight-driven mindset and the ability to translate complex business challenges into clear strategic direction. The Senior Strategy Director will guide growth diagnosis, define strategic priorities, and create the connective tissue across disciplines that ensures execution consistently ladders up to clear intent and measurable outcomes.

At our agency, strategy is not a service line, it is how we work.
The Senior Strategy Director ensures that insight, planning, and decision-making are embedded throughout the lifecycle of our client partnerships.

About Level

We're an AI-powered performance marketing agency — built for precision, designed to scale, and powered by a scientific mindset. At Level, we blend strategy, media, creative, and machine intelligence to deliver outcomes that matter. Every time. At scale.

We've been named one of Pittsburgh's Best Places to Work and an Inc. 500 Fastest-Growing Company. Our clients span B2B, education, healthcare, financial services, ecommerce, and more.

Your Role (and Impact)

What You'll Own:

Strategic Direction for Priority Accounts: You'll lead strategic direction on high-impact client engagements, ensuring that marketing activities align with clear business objectives and growth opportunities. You'll guide discovery, develop strategy briefs, and translate business challenges into structured, actionable plans
Strategic Planning & Roadmapping: You'll contribute to annual and quarterly planning cycles by developing growth roadmaps tied to measurable outcomes. You'll clarify priorities, define success metrics, and ensure teams are aligned around a shared understanding of strategic intent
Strategy Brief Development: You'll own the development of strategy briefs that define business objectives, growth priorities, audience insights, positioning, channel approach, investment logic, and measurement frameworks. These briefs will serve as the foundation that aligns cross-functional teams before execution begins
Audience, Market & Category Insights: You'll lead the development of audience insights, competitive analysis, and market intelligence that inform strategic recommendations. You'll translate research and performance data into clear implications that guide decision-making across teams
Channel Strategy & Investment Planning: You'll bring deep media strategy and planning expertise to define channel mix, sequencing, and investment logic that support growth objectives — fuelling full-funnel media plans that mature clients' media programs beyond performance marketing and extend coverage across every stage of the customer journey, from awareness through retention. You'll collaborate with media, CRM, SEO, and digital experience leaders to ensure channel decisions and budget allocation are aligned with the broader strategic framework
Measurement Frameworks & Performance Interpretation: You'll establish measurement frameworks that define success before activation begins. You'll help teams interpret performance signals, ensuring insights drive decisions rather than simply informing reporting
Strategic Performance Storytelling: You'll lead strategic narratives for Quarterly Business Reviews and planning discussions, articulating what happened, why it happened, what was learned, and what actions should follow. Your storytelling will connect data, insights, and business implications into clear recommendations
Client Strategic Partnership: You'll serve as a strategic partner for client stakeholders, confidently leading conversations around growth opportunities, planning priorities, and strategic recommendations. You'll guide discussions beyond tactical execution toward long-term business impact
Cross-Disciplinary Strategic Alignment: You'll act as the connective tissue across media, creative, SEO, CRM, web, and analytics teams to ensure that strategy is consistently integrated into execution. You'll align KPIs, messaging, channel strategies, and measurement frameworks to ensure clear business intent
Strategy Enablement Across Teams: You'll equip account and delivery teams with frameworks and guidance that elevate the quality and consistency of strategic thinking across the agency. Your work will help simplify planning and bring clarity to complex challenges
Strategic Standards & Framework Development: You'll contribute to the evolution of agency-wide strategy frameworks, playbooks, and planning tools. You'll help embed strategy into briefs, planning cycles, and optimization rhythms so that it becomes a core operating discipline
Thought Leadership & New Business Support: You'll contribute to agency POVs, category playbooks, and growth narratives that strengthen our market differentiation. You'll support new business opportunities through strategic storytelling and insight-driven positioning

Occasional travel may be requested for company events and industry conferences.

Skills & Qualifications:

Strong experience developing integrated marketing strategies across multiple channels and disciplines
Proven media strategy and planning experience, with the ability to architect full-funnel, multi-stage media plans that mature clients' programs beyond performance marketing into upper- and mid-funnel brand and demand strategies
Ability to translate business objectives into clear strategic direction that guides cross-functional teams
Strong analytical skills with the ability to derive meaningful insights from performance data, research, and market intelligence
Systems-thinking mindset with the ability to understand how messaging, channels, customer experience, and measurement connect
Excellent storytelling and communication skills, able to frame complex ideas in a clear and compelling narrative
Strong facilitation and collaboration skills, able to align cross-disciplinary teams around shared strategic priorities
Executive presence and confidence when presenting strategic recommendations to senior client stakeholders
Growth-oriented mindset with openness to feedback and continuous improvement
Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple planning cycles and strategic initiatives simultaneously
Comfort operating in ambiguous environments and bringing clarity to complex business challenges

Education & Experience:

5+ years of experience in marketing strategy, integrated strategy, brand strategy, media strategy/planning, or growth strategy within an agency or client-side environment
Demonstrated experience building and evolving media strategies across the full customer journey, not limited to lower-funnel performance channels
Demonstrated experience developing cross-channel, integrated marketing strategies
Experience guiding annual planning, strategic roadmapping, and growth discussions with clients
Experience collaborating across media, creative, digital experience, CRM, and analytics teams
Bachelor's degree in marketing, business, communications, or a related field
Industry experience in CPG or B2B is an asset but not required
Experience in the education sector (for-profit and/or not-for-profit institutions) is strongly preferred

AI Expectations

At Level, proficiency with AI tools is a core part of your role—not a nice-to-have. Your success in this position depends not only on your functional expertise, but also on your ability to actively integrate AI into how you work
You are expected to:
Experiment continuously with AI tools (eg, ChatGPT, Midjourney, Claude, Perplexity) to improve the speed, quality, and impact of your work (eg, draft briefs, summarize research, analyze data trends, generate initial strategic frameworks, identify patterns in large datasets)
Proactively document and share what you learn—your prompts, process improvements, and use cases—so others can benefit and we can grow together
Approach AI with an iterative mindset, refining how you apply it to your work over time. The first idea is rarely the best; testing, tweaking, and improving is part of the process
Lean into discomfort, especially when tools or workflows feel unfamiliar. Growth happens when you're stretching beyond what's comfortable or routine

AI is not a shortcut—it's a skillset. You're expected to use it as a force multiplier for creativity, strategy, and execution, not as a substitute for thoughtful work. As our tools evolve, your ability to adapt and lead through change will be a key part of your performance and growth at Level

Our Core Values

No Ego, All In We don't do "that's not my job." We win together, step in where needed, and care more about the outcome than the org chart
Better Every Day We want the feedback — even when it stings. We test, learn, adapt, and keep raising the bar
Relentless for Results Activity is nothing without outcomes. We care about the work that moves the business forward
Driven by Truth We challenge assumptions, follow the data, and tell clients what they need to hear — not just what is easy to say

Perks & Benefits

At Level, we support our people across the U.S. and Canada with benefits designed to promote flexibility, wellbeing, and long-term growth.

Fully remote across the U.S. & Canada, plus monthly WFH stipend and Summer Fridays
Generous time off, including unlimited PTO (U.S.), competitive vacation (Canada), and parental/family leave options
Comprehensive health benefits, mental health support, and company-paid disability & life coverage
Employer retirement contributions (401(k) in the U.S., RRSP match in Canada)
Quarterly performance reviews and career advancement opportunities

Remote First

This role is open to U.S. and Canada residents and is fully remote. Occasional travel may be requested for company events and industry conferences. We are unable to sponsor visas at this time.

Level Is Built on Inclusion

We are committed to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging. Level is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer — we celebrate what makes you, you. Level Agency provides reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities during the recruitment process. If you require an accommodation, please let us know during your application or interview process.

Ready to Apply?

Click below to submit your resume. You'll also answer a few thoughtful questions, so take your time.

We care more about how you think, how you build, and how you create impact than whether your path has been perfectly linear.

Let's build something together.

AI Hiring Disclaimer

We use AI-assisted tools to support parts of our hiring process, including resume screening and interview note-taking or summarization. These tools support, but do not replace, human judgment. All hiring decisions are made by Level's hiring team.

_____________________________________________

Télétravail - États-Unis et Canada seulement | Temps plein

Rémunération :

150 000 $ US (pour les personnes candidates résidant aux États-Unis)

new_jobs.title: Senior Strategy Director
new_jobs.description:
This job posting is available in English and Canadian French. Please scroll down for the French version.

Cette offre d'emploi est disponible en anglais et en français (Canada). Veuillez faire défiler pour la version française.

________________________________

Remote | U.S. & Canada Only | Full-Time

Compensation:

$150,000 USD (for U.S based candidates)
$150,000 CAD (for Canadian based candidates)

The Senior Strategy Director plays a central role in shaping how the agency thinks, plans, and delivers impact for clients. This role is responsible for defining strategic direction across priority accounts and ensuring that media, creative, SEO, CRM, web, and analytics teams are aligned to a unified business objective.

This role requires an insight-driven mindset and the ability to translate complex business challenges into clear strategic direction. The Senior Strategy Director will guide growth diagnosis, define strategic priorities, and create the connective tissue across disciplines that ensures execution consistently ladders up to clear intent and measurable outcomes.

At our agency, strategy is not a service line, it is how we work.
The Senior Strategy Director ensures that insight, planning, and decision-making are embedded throughout the lifecycle of our client partnerships.

About Level

We're an AI-powered performance marketing agency — built for precision, designed to scale, and powered by a scientific mindset. At Level, we blend strategy, media, creative, and machine intelligence to deliver outcomes that matter. Every time. At scale.

We've been named one of Pittsburgh's Best Places to Work and an Inc. 500 Fastest-Growing Company. Our clients span B2B, education, healthcare, financial services, ecommerce, and more.

Your Role (and Impact)

What You'll Own:

Strategic Direction for Priority Accounts: You'll lead strategic direction on high-impact client engagements, ensuring that marketing activities align with clear business objectives and growth opportunities. You'll guide discovery, develop strategy briefs, and translate business challenges into structured, actionable plans
Strategic Planning & Roadmapping: You'll contribute to annual and quarterly planning cycles by developing growth roadmaps tied to measurable outcomes. You'll clarify priorities, define success metrics, and ensure teams are aligned around a shared understanding of strategic intent
Strategy Brief Development: You'll own the development of strategy briefs that define business objectives, growth priorities, audience insights, positioning, channel approach, investment logic, and measurement frameworks. These briefs will serve as the foundation that aligns cross-functional teams before execution begins
Audience, Market & Category Insights: You'll lead the development of audience insights, competitive analysis, and market intelligence that inform strategic recommendations. You'll translate research and performance data into clear implications that guide decision-making across teams
Channel Strategy & Investment Planning: You'll bring deep media strategy and planning expertise to define channel mix, sequencing, and investment logic that support growth objectives — fuelling full-funnel media plans that mature clients' media programs beyond performance marketing and extend coverage across every stage of the customer journey, from awareness through retention. You'll collaborate with media, CRM, SEO, and digital experience leaders to ensure channel decisions and budget allocation are aligned with the broader strategic framework
Measurement Frameworks & Performance Interpretation: You'll establish measurement frameworks that define success before activation begins. You'll help teams interpret performance signals, ensuring insights drive decisions rather than simply informing reporting
Strategic Performance Storytelling: You'll lead strategic narratives for Quarterly Business Reviews and planning discussions, articulating what happened, why it happened, what was learned, and what actions should follow. Your storytelling will connect data, insights, and business implications into clear recommendations
Client Strategic Partnership: You'll serve as a strategic partner for client stakeholders, confidently leading conversations around growth opportunities, planning priorities, and strategic recommendations. You'll guide discussions beyond tactical execution toward long-term business impact
Cross-Disciplinary Strategic Alignment: You'll act as the connective tissue across media, creative, SEO, CRM, web, and analytics teams to ensure that strategy is consistently integrated into execution. You'll align KPIs, messaging, channel strategies, and measurement frameworks to ensure clear business intent
Strategy Enablement Across Teams: You'll equip account and delivery teams with frameworks and guidance that elevate the quality and consistency of strategic thinking across the agency. Your work will help simplify planning and bring clarity to complex challenges
Strategic Standards & Framework Development: You'll contribute to the evolution of agency-wide strategy frameworks, playbooks, and planning tools. You'll help embed strategy into briefs, planning cycles, and optimization rhythms so that it becomes a core operating discipline
Thought Leadership & New Business Support: You'll contribute to agency POVs, category playbooks, and growth narratives that strengthen our market differentiation. You'll support new business opportunities through strategic storytelling and insight-driven positioning

Occasional travel may be requested for company events and industry conferences.

Skills & Qualifications:

Strong experience developing integrated marketing strategies across multiple channels and disciplines
Proven media strategy and planning experience, with the ability to architect full-funnel, multi-stage media plans that mature clients' programs beyond performance marketing into upper- and mid-funnel brand and demand strategies
Ability to translate business objectives into clear strategic direction that guides cross-functional teams
Strong analytical skills with the ability to derive meaningful insights from performance data, research, and market intelligence
Systems-thinking mindset with the ability to understand how messaging, channels, customer experience, and measurement connect
Excellent storytelling and communication skills, able to frame complex ideas in a clear and compelling narrative
Strong facilitation and collaboration skills, able to align cross-disciplinary teams around shared strategic priorities
Executive presence and confidence when presenting strategic recommendations to senior client stakeholders
Growth-oriented mindset with openness to feedback and continuous improvement
Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple planning cycles and strategic initiatives simultaneously
Comfort operating in ambiguous environments and bringing clarity to complex business challenges

Education & Experience:

5+ years of experience in marketing strategy, integrated strategy, brand strategy, media strategy/planning, or growth strategy within an agency or client-side environment
Demonstrated experience building and evolving media strategies across the full customer journey, not limited to lower-funnel performance channels
Demonstrated experience developing cross-channel, integrated marketing strategies
Experience guiding annual planning, strategic roadmapping, and growth discussions with clients
Experience collaborating across media, creative, digital experience, CRM, and analytics teams
Bachelor's degree in marketing, business, communications, or a related field
Industry experience in CPG or B2B is an asset but not required
Experience in the education sector (for-profit and/or not-for-profit institutions) is strongly preferred

AI Expectations

At Level, proficiency with AI tools is a core part of your role—not a nice-to-have. Your success in this position depends not only on your functional expertise, but also on your ability to actively integrate AI into how you work
You are expected to:
Experiment continuously with AI tools (eg, ChatGPT, Midjourney, Claude, Perplexity) to improve the speed, quality, and impact of your work (eg, draft briefs, summarize research, analyze data trends, generate initial strategic frameworks, identify patterns in large datasets)
Proactively document and share what you learn—your prompts, process improvements, and use cases—so others can benefit and we can grow together
Approach AI with an iterative mindset, refining how you apply it to your work over time. The first idea is rarely the best; testing, tweaking, and improving is part of the process
Lean into discomfort, especially when tools or workflows feel unfamiliar. Growth happens when you're stretching beyond what's comfortable or routine

AI is not a shortcut—it's a skillset. You're expected to use it as a force multiplier for creativity, strategy, and execution, not as a substitute for thoughtful work. As our tools evolve, your ability to adapt and lead through change will be a key part of your performance and growth at Level

Our Core Values

No Ego, All In We don't do "that's not my job." We win together, step in where needed, and care more about the outcome than the org chart
Better Every Day We want the feedback — even when it stings. We test, learn, adapt, and keep raising the bar
Relentless for Results Activity is nothing without outcomes. We care about the work that moves the business forward
Driven by Truth We challenge assumptions, follow the data, and tell clients what they need to hear — not just what is easy to say

Perks & Benefits

At Level, we support our people across the U.S. and Canada with benefits designed to promote flexibility, wellbeing, and long-term growth.

Fully remote across the U.S. & Canada, plus monthly WFH stipend and Summer Fridays
Generous time off, including unlimited PTO (U.S.), competitive vacation (Canada), and parental/family leave options
Comprehensive health benefits, mental health support, and company-paid disability & life coverage
Employer retirement contributions (401(k) in the U.S., RRSP match in Canada)
Quarterly performance reviews and career advancement opportunities

Remote First

This role is open to U.S. and Canada residents and is fully remote. Occasional travel may be requested for company events and industry conferences. We are unable to sponsor visas at this time.

Level Is Built on Inclusion

We are committed to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging. Level is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer — we celebrate what makes you, you. Level Agency provides reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities during the recruitment process. If you require an accommodation, please let us know during your application or interview process.

Ready to Apply?

Click below to submit your resume. You'll also answer a few thoughtful questions, so take your time.

We care more about how you think, how you build, and how you create impact than whether your path has been perfectly linear.

Let's build something together.

AI Hiring Disclaimer

We use AI-assisted tools to support parts of our hiring process, including resume screening and interview note-taking or summarization. These tools support, but do not replace, human judgment. All hiring decisions are made by Level's hiring team.
